description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'ViewsFormBase' for handling AJAX forms related to Views UI in Drupal. It includes methods for form state management, AJAX response handling, and form rendering, specifically for AJAX interactions within the Views module.

classes.name: ViewsFormBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for AJAX forms in Views UI, including form state management, AJAX response handling, and form rendering.

methods.name: getFormState
methods.description: Prepares and returns the form state object with relevant parameters for the AJAX form.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Generates the AJAX form, handles form stack, cache, and redirects, and returns the AJAX response or form markup.

methods.name: ajaxFormWrapper
methods.description: Handles AJAX form rendering, including building the form, attaching AJAX commands, and returning the response.
